text:
Priya Rao: Heads-up: thinking about a "Compute Affinity" add-on — customers pay to pin workloads to premium GPU pools (A100x, H100) w/ tighter latency SLOs. Need input on pricing shape, commit floor, and constraints for Hosted vs Dedicated. TL;DR: premium performance packaging. Thoughts?

Alex Chen: Sounds promising. Key infra constraints: affinity increases capacity fragmentation. Need to require >= monthly commit or higher per-route burst pricing. Also require certain model sizes — >40B to justify pinned GPU.

Jordan Lee: Sales: customers ask for "guaranteed GPU class" often. They'll pay 20–40% premium if latency win is clear. But sales/legal want minimum contract term (6–12 months). Partner/reseller pricing needs a carveout.

Maria Gonzales: Finance: run the unit economics. Quick rule: price = baseline + cap_slot_premium where cap_slot_premium = 0.3 * baseline compute cost. Recommend trial credits for first 30 days and a 6mo commit floor for profitability.

Priya Rao: Proposed config snippet:
```
{
  "affinity_name": "compute_affinity",
  "affinity_premium_pct": "30%",
  "min_commit_months": "6",
  "eligible_deployments": ["dedicated", "hosted-enterprise"],
  "fallback_policy": "auto-failover-to-compatible-variant",
  "burst_rate_limit_per_min": "1000"
}
```

Alex Chen: Implementation notes: can't combine with 'shared-slab' and some autoscale policies. Rollout plan: alpha on Dedicated pools only, then Hosted for large accounts. Need a migration playbook for when capacity is exhausted.

Jordan Lee: Customer ops: external doc should show supported regions & model families. Also define the fallback UX and a credit policy (e.g., 5% SLA credit on involuntary downgrade).

deploy-bot: @channel Note: feature flags will be created under `affinity/*` and gated by capacity checks. Deploy date TBD.

Maria Gonzales: Launch criteria proposal: 3 paying customers on Dedicated; 2 benchmarked use-cases showing >=20% p95 latency improvement; and unit economics >=20% gross margin on premium.

Priya Rao: Decision items for Friday sync: choose price band (20% / 30% / 40%), commit floor (1 / 6 / 12 months), and confirmed launch gating. Proposed demo Fri 10:00am. @Jordan Lee can you confirm AE loop-in?

Alex Chen: :thumbsup: I will bring infra cost + expected fragmentation model. Also add metric: `affinity_fragmentation_pct` for Console.

Jordan Lee: I'll loop in Enterprise AE and legal; expect initial feedback by Wed.

Priya Rao: Thanks all — adding notes to the roadmap ticket and will update the PRD draft after feedback. :sparkles:
